title: erigeron tetrapleurus
intro: Erigeron tetrapleurus, commonly known as the four-angled fleabane or mountain daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to North America. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antibacterial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron tetrapleurus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects on human health.
